title: SequentialRingCriteriaPut
description: Request body for updating sequential ring criteria settings.

scheduleName.description: Name of the schedule to be associated with the criteria.

scheduleType.description:
Type of the schedule.
 * `businessHours` - Business hours schedule type.
 * `holidays` - Holidays schedule type.

scheduleLevel.description:
* `PEOPLE` - The schedule is at the user level.
 * `LOCATION` - The schedule is at the location level.

callsFrom.description:
Specifies the type of calling numbers the criteria applies to.
 * `ANY_PHONE_NUMBER` - The criteria applies to any phone number.
 * `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS` - The criteria applies to selected phone numbers.

anonymousCallersEnabled.description: When `true`, means this criteria applies for anonymous callers. Required if `callsFrom` is `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS`.

unavailableCallersEnabled.description: When `true`, means this criteria applies for unavailable callers. Required if `callsFrom` is `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS`.

phoneNumbers.description: List of phone numbers to update for this criteria. Required if `callsFrom` is `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS`.

items.description: Phone number that the criteria applies to. If SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS has been selected

ringEnabled.description: Determines whether sequential ring is applied for calls matching this criteria. If `true`, sequential ring is applied. Criteria with ringEnabled set to false have precedence over criteria with ringEnabled set to true.
